testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/verify-shipping-promotion-and-coupon-cap.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > the shipping promotion applies with no coupon and covers the shipping charge

scenario.summary: A guest empties the cart, adds one simple product so the order clears the shipping promotion minimum, checks out as guest with the flat-rate shipping method, and checks that the automatic shipping promotion discounts the shipping charge in full with no coupon entered. No order is placed.
steps: Guest: open the home page and empty the cart
Add productSku at quantity 1, open the cart and check out as guest
Fill the guest address and select the flat-rate shipping method
Wait until the shipping line is above 0
Read the checkout totals: subtotal above promotionMinimumOrder, shipping above 0, shipping discount above 0 and at least the shipping charge
stateChanges: Guest cart: emptied and product added (left in the guest cart)
assertions: Shipping discount is greater than or equal to shipping
evidence: Title: 'the shipping promotion applies with no coupon and covers the shipping charge'; linked ZPD-TC-11577
Spec header: coverage gap fill derived from the Selenium shipping-discount specs (ZPD-TC-11577), guest flow, no account touched, no order placed.

Spec header (atstage 2026-09-25): the automatic PromoAmountOffShippingWithCarrier promotion ($2.00 off shipping, minimum order $100, store Maxwell's Hardware) covers the flat-rate shipping charge with no code entered.

Missing key: an automatic (no coupon) Amount Off Shipping promotion on MaxwellsHardware for the Anonymous profile (or all profiles), active now, with a minimum order amount (orderMinimum output) and a discount at least the flat-rate shipping charge, applying to the Custom Flat Rate (FLAT) method. No vocabulary key covers shipping promotions; the need is left out. promotionMinimumOrder (100) is its orderMinimum and is recorded as expected-output only because a data source needs a declared alias; re-map it to that need (output orderMinimum) once the key exists.

Missing param: the cart (productSku at quantity 1) must exceed the shipping promotion minimum (subtotal > promotionMinimumOrder); PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK has maxPrice but no minimum price, so the need cannot express it. Recorded product z-1234567 (DeWalt Cordless Propane Radiant Heater, active SimpleProduct, PRODUCTION, profiled for a PDP spec) is the preferred record.
selectFlatRateAnyLayout clicks #FLAT-1 (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE with shippingCode FLAT; destination country assumed 'us' (address masked); assumption.
Guest address values (masked) are typed by the test: role config, never customer data.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every atstage webstore spec runs on (same as the approved shopping-cart and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
Profile (atstage, generated 2026-10-31T17:34) has no observations for this spec (scanned 2026-11-01): every source is profiled false.
Values only in the spec header comment (SHIPOFF, ORDER15, $2.00, $100, 15.00) are evidence, not data in code; the spec reads every data value through loadData.
